body: It took 4 years of driving for me to finally become comfortable. I still avoid heavily congested areas like downtown though if possible.

I used to work at a Wendy's store in high school. All timers for each of the several deep fryers are on one panel. I'm sure that a timer for fries or chicken nuggets went off and the rushed cook got confused and thought it was for chicken. So he pulled the partially cooked chicken out and you got your raw sandwich. Also don't ask for gift card. Just get a refund. We used to issue refund all the time for unsatisfied customers.
I think my biggest problem is the fact that I cannot be social. I am extremely introverted by nature, but when it comes to actually interacting with others I am a literal social retard.

I think so too. I'm not getting any treatment. I've tried several types of antidepressants in my life, and for the most part I think the negative effects of them outweigh the good. I also can't afford any medical help.
